questions.question: Describe the symmetry of a five-armed starfish.
questions.expected_answer: A starfish has 5 lines of symmetry, one through each arm. It also looks the same after a fifth of a full turn about its centre, so its pattern shows rotation.

questions.question: Describe a Ndebele wall painting using maths words.
questions.expected_answer: It uses bold straight lines, rectangles and triangles. Many designs have a line of symmetry down the middle, and the border repeats the same design along the wall by translation.

questions.question: Give one example of translation and one example of rotation in modern everyday life.
questions.expected_answer: A brick wall shows translation, because the same brick is repeated by sliding. A car hubcap shows rotation, because it looks the same after a small turn about its centre.
